Home.heroTitle: Innovating the Future with  Artificial Intelligence
Home.heroDescription: Inova AI is a solution provider solving problems across daily life and industries with advanced technology—from the 'Sniff by Hatch' platform for pet families to hospital systems, GMP document automation, and industrial 'FEM & AI' optimization.
Home.coreDescription: We leverage AI to solve complex challenges across multiple industries.
Home.service1Desc: A revolutionary AI platform for early detection of health concerns through medical questionnaires used in hospitals and image analysis.
Home.service2Desc: An AI-assisted diagnostic system optimized for veterinary clinics to support accurate diagnoses.
Home.service3Desc: Optimizing pharmaceutical CSV workflows and automating the GMP documentation process.
Home.service4Desc: Integrating the Finite Element Method with AI to accelerate industrial design and simulation accuracy.
Home.service5Desc: Deploying intelligent AI agents to improve inefficient workflows and maximize productivity.

Automation.heroDescription: Optimize your business processes with intelligent AI agents. Reduce repetitive tasks and focus on what matters most.
Automation.feature1Desc: We build customized AI agents that intelligently handle repetitive tasks.
Automation.feature2Desc: We analyze inefficient workflows and automate them in the most efficient way.
Automation.feature3Desc: We monitor automated task performance in real-time and provide analytical reports.

Footer.description: From veterinarians to simulation experts, specialists from entirely different fields collaborate without boundaries—a boundary-breaking startup obsessively exploring the new possibilities of AI to resolve complex industrial challenges.

About.heroDescription: As an AI-native startup, we redefine pet healthcare. We also encourage AI adoption in the pharmaceutical and manufacturing industries, bridging the gap to support professional-grade work across all sectors.
About.missionDesc1: Detecting health issues early is the key to longevity. We believe every pet owner deserves access to immediate, accurate health insights without waiting for an appointment.
About.missionDesc2: By combining advanced computer vision with the knowledge of experienced veterinarians, we create a safety net that never sleeps.
About.vetLedDesc: Co-founded by a practicing veterinarian (DVM) to ensure clinical validity in every algorithm we build.
About.petCentricDesc: Everything we build focuses on increasing industrial efficiency, minimizing stress and maximizing effectiveness.
About.journeyNowDesc: Launch of Sniff by Hatch beta.
About.journeyNextDesc: Enhancing stability for veterinarians and pet owners.
About.journeyFutureDesc: Promoting global service plans targeting the US and Europe.

Technology.heroDesc: We combine state-of-the-art Computer Vision with Large Language Models to simulate a veterinary consultation.
Technology.cvDesc: Our fine-tuned CNN/Transformer hybrid models are trained on a proprietary dataset of dermatological and dental conditions in dogs and cats.
Technology.llmDesc: We use advanced LLMs to conduct dynamic medical interviews (anamnesis) and synthesize visual findings into a coherent report.
Technology.llmFeature2: Medical jargon translation for pet owners
Technology.backendDesc: Powered by FastAPI and microservices architecture to ensure low-latency responses and high availability.
Technology.privacyDesc: We adhere to strict data privacy standards. Images are processed anonymously where possible, and personal data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
Technology.patentSectionDesc: INOVA.AI has secured patents for our core technology, protecting our unique approach to combining biosignals with questionnaire data.
Technology.patentTitleEn: "AI-based Pet Health Assessment System using Questionnaire and Biosignals"

Sniff.heroDesc: Sniff by Hatch uses advanced visual recognition AI to monitor your pet's health. Simply take a photo and get instant insights into their well-being.
Sniff.step1Desc:
Please fill out the questionnaire first.
You can leave the parts you don't know blank.
Sniff.step2Desc:
Please take a clear photo of your dog/cat's eyes, teeth, skin, etc.
Even if you think the posture is unusual, please take a full-body photo.
Sniff.step3Desc: Our deep learning model analyzes the image to provide an instant health status report.
Sniff.whyDesc: We bridge the gap between home care and veterinary visits using state-of-the-art AI technology.
Sniff.feature1Desc: Our AI analyzes visual cues from photos (skin, teeth, wounds) and combines them with symptom history for accurate assessments.
Sniff.feature2Desc: Developed with leading veterinarians to ensure medical relevance. Critical cases are flagged for immediate professional care.
Sniff.feature3Desc: Track your pet's health timeline. Detect subtle changes early before they become serious issues.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: InovaAI (hereinafter the "Company") complies with the Personal Information Protection Act and related laws and regulations, and established this Privacy Policy to protect the personal information of users (hereinafter "Users") who use the Sniff by Hatch application (hereinafter the "App").
section1List1: Basic Pet Info: Species (dog/cat), breed, date of birth/age, weight, gender, neutering status, etc.
Pet Living Info: Eating habits, living environment, other pets, vaccination and parasite prevention info, etc.
Health Questionnaire: Current symptoms, past/current illness and treatment history, guardian's concerns, etc.
Photos for Analysis: Pet photos uploaded directly by the user.
Device Information: OS type, app version, usage logs, and other minimal technical information to ensure service stability.
section1List2: Email Address and Nickname: For sending result reports, responding to inquiries, and service announcements.
Other information voluntarily entered by the user.
Privacy.section2Intro: The Company uses the collected information for the following purposes:
section2List: Pet health analysis and providing result reports
Providing analysis services using AI models such as Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT-4, etc.
Service quality improvement, statistical analysis, and error/failure response
Processing user inquiries and customer support
section3List: In principle, personal information is destroyed immediately once the purpose of collection and use is achieved.
Information necessary for service operation and analysis advancement is kept for up to 1 year from the date of collection and then destroyed.
If preservation is required by relevant laws, it will be kept only for the period specified by the law.
If a user directly requests deletion, it will be deleted without delay within the range permitted by law.
Privacy.section4Title: 4. Provision to Third Parties and International Transfer
Privacy.section4Text1: The Company does not provide personal information to third parties without the user's prior consent. However, exceptions may be made if there is a legal basis or a legitimate request from an investigative agency.
Privacy.section4Text2: Some information may be transferred to and stored on overseas servers for the use of the services below:
Privacy.section4Footer2: The Company complies with the terms and policies of these service providers, transmits and processes data only within the scope of service provision purposes, and takes necessary protective measures as required by law.
Privacy.section5Text: The Company may entrust some tasks to external companies as needed for service provision. In this case, personal information protection obligations are clearly defined through entrustment contracts in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act.
section6List: Personal information that has passed the retention period or reached the processing purpose is destroyed without delay according to internal policies.
Information in electronic file format is deleted using technical methods that make recovery impossible.
Paper documents are destroyed through shredding or incineration.
Privacy.section7Title: 7. User Rights and How to Exercise Them
section7List: Users can request access, correction, deletion, or suspension of processing of their personal information at any time.
Requests can be made through the in-app inquiry function or email (support@inovaai.ai).
The Company will take necessary measures without delay after verifying identity and will provide guidance if there are legal restrictions.
Privacy.section8Title: 8. Security Measures for Protecting Personal Information
Privacy.section8Intro: The Company takes the following measures for the safe processing of personal information:
section8List: Data protection through transmission section encryption (HTTPS/SSL, etc.)
Minimizing personal information handling personnel and managing access rights
Regular security checks and log monitoring
Preventing unauthorized access to systems and data
section9List: This app does not directly target children under 14 and provides services to guardians (adults).
If the Company becomes aware that personal information of a child under 14 has been collected, it will take measures to delete it immediately.
Privacy.section10Intro: The Company designates a Personal Information Protection Officer as below to handle inquiries related to personal information protection:
section11List: This policy may be modified according to changes in laws or service content.
Important changes will be noticed in advance through in-app or website announcements.
The modified policy takes effect from the date of implementation posted on the website.
Privacy.finalNote: This Privacy Policy was enacted on November 1, 2025, and any subsequent changes will be announced through the InovaAI website.

② "User" refers to members and non-members who use the Service provided by the Company in accordance with these Terms.

④ "Non-member" refers to a person who uses the Service within the range allowed by the Company without registering for membership.
⑤ "Content" refers to information, text, images, videos, software, AI analysis results, reports, and all other materials provided in the Service or generated/displayed during the Service use process.
⑥ "Paid Service" refers to subscriptions, functions, contents, or any other services provided by the Company for a fee.
⑦ "Recurring Payment (Subscription)" refers to a type of Paid Service where the User registers a payment method and the usage fee is automatically paid at regular intervals.

⑧ "Third-party Service" refers to Firebase authentication, Payment Gateway (PG), app markets (e.g., Apple App Store, Google Play), hospital/institutional systems, and other services and systems provided by third parties other than the Company.
⑨ Terms not defined in this article shall follow relevant laws and general commercial practices.

SniffHospital.title: Sniff for Hospital
SniffHospital.heroTitle: Professional AI Diagnostics for Veterinary Clinics
SniffHospital.heroDesc: Empower your clinic with Sniff's professional-grade AI analysis. Enhance diagnostic accuracy and streamline patient intake with visual health recognition.
SniffHospital.featuresDesc: Advanced diagnostic tools designed for professional veterinary environments.
SniffHospital.feature1Desc: High-resolution visual analysis for dermatological, ophthalmic, and dental assessments.
SniffHospital.feature2Desc: Seamlessly link AI diagnostic results with your existing Hospital Management System (HMS).
SniffHospital.feature3Desc: Provide visual proof and AI-backed reports to build confidence with pet owners.

CSVAutomation.heroDesc: Automate your Computer System Validation (CSV) workflows. Ensure GxP compliance with higher accuracy and significantly reduced manual effort.
CSVAutomation.feature1Desc: Automatically generate and manage complex CSV output documents through AI.
CSVAutomation.feature2Desc: 100% compliant with guidelines from global regulatory agencies like FDA and EMA.
CSVAutomation.feature3Desc: Cut validation time by up to 60% or more compared to manual processes.

FemAi.heroDesc: Accelerating engineering simulations by combining traditional Finite Element Method with deep learning acceleration.
FemAi.conceptDesc: Traditional FEM simulations are computationally expensive and time-consuming. Inova AI integrates Surrogate Models and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to provide near-instant results with high fidelity.
FemAi.feature1Desc: Instantaneous structural response analysis for design iteration.
FemAi.feature2Desc: Automatically find optimal structures based on desired performance parameters.
